# Vocabulary

Namespace `http://example.org/mini-amt/` (placeholder, to be replaced by a persistent IRI).

## Concepts

### mini:Actor

Person working at a production centre (the source model's ActorEntity and Actor are collapsed here).

### mini:InformationCarrier

The object carrying the information (e.g. a stamped vessel or sherd).

### mini:Potform

Vessel form or type (the typological class of an information carrier).

### mini:ProductionCentre

Place of production (e.g. a kiln site).

## Roles

Grouped by how a role comes into being. *Limit* is what the role does not say, and that matters archaeologically.

### Asserted

#### mini:hasProductionCentre

The information carrier is attributed to this production centre, i.e. it is assumed to have been produced there.

- **Limit:** An attribution, not a proof. Its weight is the degree to which the attribution holds.
- **Domain to range:** `InformationCarrier` to `ProductionCentre`
- **Inverse:** `isProductionCentreOf`

#### mini:hasType

The information carrier is of this potform.

- **Limit:** A classification of the carrier. It does not say where the potform was produced.
- **Domain to range:** `InformationCarrier` to `Potform`
- **Inverse:** `isTypeOf`

#### mini:worksAt

The actor worked at this production centre.

- **Limit:** Says nothing about when. The period in which the actor was active is not part of the role.
- **Domain to range:** `Actor` to `ProductionCentre`
- **Inverse:** `hasWorker`

### Inverse of an asserted role

#### mini:hasWorker

This actor worked at the production centre. Inverse of worksAt.

- **Limit:** The same statement as worksAt, read from the centre. No time is implied.
- **Domain to range:** `ProductionCentre` to `Actor`
- **Inverse:** `worksAt`

#### mini:isProductionCentreOf

The production centre is the attributed place of production of this information carrier. Inverse of hasProductionCentre.

- **Limit:** Not used by a role chain; kept so that every role has its inverse.
- **Domain to range:** `ProductionCentre` to `InformationCarrier`
- **Inverse:** `hasProductionCentre`

#### mini:isTypeOf

The potform is the type of this information carrier. Inverse of hasType (agreed with Allard Mees).

- **Limit:** The same statement as hasType, read from the potform: one potform is the type of many carriers.
- **Domain to range:** `Potform` to `InformationCarrier`
- **Inverse:** `hasType`

### Derived (>>)

#### mini:carrierToActor

The information carrier is associated with the actor: the carrier is attributed to a centre at which the actor worked.

- **Limit:** A shared-centre association, not an attribution of authorship. The time intervals of carrier and actor are not compared.
- **Domain to range:** `InformationCarrier` to `Actor`
- **Inverse:** `actorToCarrier`
- **Derived by:** `RCA_carrierToActor` (`hasProductionCentre o hasWorker`)

#### mini:potformToActor

The potform is associated with the actor: a carrier of this type is attributed to a centre at which the actor worked.

- **Limit:** The weakest of the three associations: three steps, two of them through the same centre. It does not say that the actor produced this potform.
- **Domain to range:** `Potform` to `Actor`
- **Inverse:** `actorToPotform`
- **Derived by:** `RCA_potformToActor` (`isTypeOf o hasProductionCentre o hasWorker`)

#### mini:potformToCentre

The potform is associated with the production centre: a carrier of this type is attributed to that centre.

- **Limit:** An association through at least one carrier. It does not say that the centre produced all, or most, carriers of the potform.
- **Domain to range:** `Potform` to `ProductionCentre`
- **Inverse:** `centreToPotform`
- **Derived by:** `RCA_potformToCentre` (`isTypeOf o hasProductionCentre`)

### Derived inverse (<<)

#### mini:actorToCarrier

The actor is associated with the information carrier: the actor worked at the centre to which the carrier is attributed. Inverse of carrierToActor.

- **Limit:** Candidate carriers of the actor, not carriers the actor is known to have made.
- **Domain to range:** `Actor` to `InformationCarrier`
- **Inverse:** `carrierToActor`

#### mini:actorToPotform

The actor is associated with the potform: the forms attested at the centre where the actor worked. Inverse of potformToActor.

- **Limit:** A candidate repertoire of the actor, derived from the centre. It is not the actor's own repertoire.
- **Domain to range:** `Actor` to `Potform`
- **Inverse:** `potformToActor`

#### mini:centreToPotform

The production centre is associated with the potform: a carrier attributed to the centre is of this type. Inverse of potformToCentre.

- **Limit:** Read from the centre, this is its attested range of forms as far as carriers are attributed to it. It is neither complete nor proportional.
- **Domain to range:** `ProductionCentre` to `Potform`
- **Inverse:** `potformToCentre`

### Generic (>>)

#### mini:reaches

Generic derived role (>>): any of the three derived association roles. One query on it finds all of them.

- **Limit:** Has no domain or range because it spans several concept pairs.
- **Inverse:** `reachedBy`

### Generic inverse (<<)

#### mini:reachedBy

Generic derived inverse role (<<). Inverse of reaches.

- **Limit:** Has no domain or range because it spans several concept pairs.
- **Inverse:** `reaches`

## Axioms

### Inverse axioms

| Axiom | Antecedent | Inverse |
|---|---|---|
| `INV_carrierToActor` | `carrierToActor` | `actorToCarrier` |
| `INV_hasProductionCentre` | `hasProductionCentre` | `isProductionCentreOf` |
| `INV_hasType` | `hasType` | `isTypeOf` |
| `INV_potformToActor` | `potformToActor` | `actorToPotform` |
| `INV_potformToCentre` | `potformToCentre` | `centreToPotform` |
| `INV_reaches` | `reaches` | `reachedBy` |
| `INV_worksAt` | `worksAt` | `hasWorker` |

The weight of the antecedent edge is copied to the inverse edge.

### Role chains

| Axiom | Antecedents (in order) | Consequent | Logic |
|---|---|---|---|
| `RCA_carrierToActor` | `hasProductionCentre o hasWorker` | `carrierToActor` | `ProductLogic` (proposal) |
| `RCA_potformToActor` | `isTypeOf o hasProductionCentre o hasWorker` | `potformToActor` | `ProductLogic` (proposal) |
| `RCA_potformToCentre` | `isTypeOf o hasProductionCentre` | `potformToCentre` | `ProductLogic` (proposal) |

### Subsumption axioms

| Axiom | Sub-role | Super-role |
|---|---|---|
| `SUB_carrierToActor` | `carrierToActor` | `reaches` |
| `SUB_potformToActor` | `potformToActor` | `reaches` |
| `SUB_potformToCentre` | `potformToCentre` | `reaches` |
